prerequisites: The Student has got a basic knowledge in the field of materials science and chemistry.

learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the basic groups of polymers, their structure, properties.
The student knows the technology used for the processing of polymeric materials,
The student knows the basic applications of polymeric materials.
Is able to identify polymeric materials.
Can indicate the processing technology for producing a selected product from the plastic material,
Place the selected polymeric materials for specific applications.
Searches of information and its critical analysis,
Team cooperation on improving methods for the selection of a strategy to optimally solve problems assigned to the group
Compliance with the customs and rules of the academic community.

syllabus_topics: Basics, nomenclature. Classification and distribution of polymeric materials.
Preparation of polymers and plastics. Polymerization processes and the production of plastic materials
Structure of the polymers and the resulting properties.
Models mechanical behavior of polymers.
Rheology and behavior of materials during processing.
Transformation of plastics, the impact of environmental conditions on the behavior of polymeric materials.
The basic group of polymeric materials and their specific properties.
Methods for modification of polymeric materials and their impact on the property.
Preparation of polymer composites.
Overview of polymeric construction materials - Properties and application of thermoplastic materials.
Overview of polymeric construction materials - Properties and application of chemically-and thermosetting plastics and elastomers.
Primary processing technologies plastics - injection molding
Technologies primary processing of polymeric materials - extrusion
Technologies secondary processing of polymeric materials - thermoforming
Manufacturing technologies of chemicallysetted polymers
Polymeric materials and methods for their identification
Technologies of plastics parts joning
Primary processing technology - injecting molding
Secondary processing technologies - Vacuum thermoforming and blow molding
Friction and wear test of polymeric materials
Research sagging body wall - analytical methods and experimental
Thermosetting plastics processing technologies - casting and pressing
Tools for processing of plastics
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class

assessment_methods.method: oral answer, report for PEK_K01, PEK_K02, PEK_K03 (laboratory)

assessment_rules: The final grade for the lecture (P) is the average of two formative tests (F1 and F2). The final grade for the laboratory (P) is the average of four formative assessments (F1, F2, F3, F4).
